test_controls.name: Password Policy
test_controls.description: Implement a policy requiring complex passwords with minimum length of 12 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters. Passwords must be changed every 90 days.
test_controls.test_scenario: Testing password-related controls and authentication policies

test_controls.name: Security Incident Handling
test_controls.description: Establish procedures for detecting, reporting, and responding to security incidents, including data breaches. Team members should be trained on incident response procedures and regular drills conducted.
test_controls.test_scenario: Testing incident response and handling procedures

test_controls.name: Asset Inventory Management
test_controls.description: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all hardware devices and software applications in the organization. Regular audits should be conducted to identify unauthorized devices or software.
test_controls.test_scenario: Testing asset management and inventory controls

test_controls.name: System Configuration Control
test_controls.description: Implement strict configuration management processes for all systems, including version control, change approval, and baseline configurations. Regular audits of system configurations should be performed.

test_controls.name: Physical Access Security
test_controls.description: Control physical access to facilities and equipment through access cards, biometric systems, and visitor management. Maintain logs of all physical access and regularly review security camera footage.

test_controls.name: Network Segmentation
test_controls.description: Implement network segmentation to separate critical systems from general-purpose networks. Use firewalls and access controls to restrict traffic between segments.
test_controls.test_scenario: Testing network security and segmentation controls

test_controls.name: Security Training Program
test_controls.description: Conduct regular security awareness training for all employees, covering topics like phishing, social engineering, and secure data handling. Training should be tailored to different roles.
test_controls.test_scenario: Testing security awareness and training controls

test_controls.name: Vulnerability Management
test_controls.description: Regular vulnerability scanning and penetration testing of all systems. Implement a process for prioritizing and patching vulnerabilities based on risk level.

test_controls.name: Audit Logging
test_controls.description: Enable comprehensive logging of all system activities, including user actions, system changes, and security events. Logs should be protected and regularly reviewed.

test_controls.name: Change Management
test_controls.description: All system changes must go through a formal change management process including risk assessment, approval, testing, and rollback procedures.
test_controls.test_scenario: Testing change management and maintenance controls
